name: Transcripts
description: Transcribes call audio with Whisper and shows it in the scanner.
author: Rdio Scanner

config.label: Enable transcription
config.help: Transcribe call audio as it arrives.

config.label: Provider
config.help: Which transcription backend to use. Each provider's URL, key and model are stored separately, so switching between them does not lose credentials. Only the settings for the selected provider are shown.

config.label: Groq — base URL
config.help: OpenAI-compatible base URL. The server appends /audio/transcriptions itself.

config.label: Groq — API key(s)
config.help: Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>. Several keys may be given, separated by commas, semicolons or newlines — requests round-robin across them and each backs off independently on 429.

config.label: Groq — model
config.help: Any model identifier Groq accepts on its /audio/transcriptions endpoint.

config.label: Whisper (OpenAI) — API key(s)
config.help: Secret API key (sk-…), sent as Authorization: Bearer. Several may be given, separated by commas, semicolons or newlines.

config.label: Whisper (OpenAI) — model
config.help: Any model identifier OpenAI accepts on its /audio/transcriptions endpoint.

config.label: Whisper (self-hosted) — base URL
config.help: URL of your own Whisper server — whisper.cpp, faster-whisper-server, or anything else exposing an OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions endpoint. Enter only the base path; the server appends the rest. Required — there is no default.

config.label: Whisper (self-hosted) — API key(s)
config.help: Optional. Leave blank if your server needs no authentication.

config.label: Whisper (self-hosted) — model
config.help: Whatever model identifier your server expects.

config.label: Language
config.help: Optional ISO-639-1 code such as en. Leave blank to auto-detect.

config.label: Prompt (global fallback)
config.help: Optional prompt biasing Whisper toward your vocabulary — unit IDs, 10-codes, agency names. Used for systems that have no prompt of their own. Groq enforces a hard 896-character cap and longer values are truncated when sending to it, keeping the trailing portion; other providers receive the prompt as-is.

config.label: Max transcriptions / minute (per key)
config.help: Per-key cap on requests in the last 60 seconds. Groq enforces 30/min per key, so set 30 or a little below. Effective throughput is this × number of keys. 0 disables the cap. When every key is at its limit or backing off on a 429, incoming calls are skipped rather than queued.

config.label: Minimum audio size
config.help: Skip transcription for clips smaller than this many bytes. Tiny clips are usually squelch bursts or mic-keys that waste quota. 0 disables the filter; 8000 is roughly 2 seconds at typical rdio bitrates.

config.label: Wait for transcript
config.help: Every client holds each call's audio playback for up to 15 seconds until its transcript is ready, then plays. If Whisper does not answer in time the call plays without one — no calls are lost. Applies to all clients globally.

config.label: Show retranscribe button
config.help: Exposes a per-row retranscribe button on the Search Call page for authenticated admins. Leave off to keep the UI clean — retranscription is still available through the admin API.

config.label: Concurrent transcriptions
config.help: How many calls may be in flight at once.
